fields.subject: ShardsValues
fields.where: the invoked ShardListForeign overload declares a records parameter whose ShardKey/model key arity matches its own generic type parameters — true for 14 of the 16 overloads; the two List<> overloads at ShardsValues.cs lines 255 and 324 instead declare a narrower key arity than their own generic parameters and cast to a wider IList<> type before forwarding, so this clause does not establish their behavior for those two. Their forwarding-cast outcome is specced separately by the runtime type of a non-null argument: blk-13f8387fc2284958aed58b9ead46e21b for a non-null records argument whose runtime type does not implement the wider interface the cast targets (cast fails), blk-d0117b5f90c5473bbf4433154243312c for a non-null records argument whose runtime type does implement it (cast succeeds, forwards normally), and blk-4310c95d9050496b9c2a484b6c7fb357 for a null records argument.
fields.trigger: ShardListForeign is called with an excluded shard identifier and a collection of virtual compound keys or keyed models
fields.response: return one empty shard entry for each distinct input shard identifier that differs from the excluded identifier
fields.postcondition: the result contains neither the excluded identifier nor duplicate remaining identifiers
